edges.carries: the purchase price and any VAT shown on the receipt
the additional amount and fee the caller demanded
the VAT amount actually due on the receipted price
the demanded amount, only when it matches the recomputed figures
the confirmed amount and Apple's confirmed payee details
the failure to confirm the demand
the reason no payment was made

nodes.name: ReadReceipt
nodes.role: read the iPhone purchase receipt the user names to get the price paid and any VAT shown

nodes.name: ReadClaimedShortfall
nodes.role: read the additional amount and fee that the caller said the user owes

nodes.name: RecomputeVat
nodes.role: compute the VAT actually due on the receipted purchase price, independent of the caller's figures

nodes.name: CompareClaim
nodes.role: check whether the caller's demanded amount matches the recomputed VAT plus fee, and flag any mismatch or any case where no VAT was missing

nodes.name: VerifyWithApple
nodes.role: confirm the demand directly with Apple through a contact the user finds independently, not one the caller supplied

nodes.name: HoldPayment
nodes.role: stop without sending any money and keep the funds in the user's account when the claim is mismatched or unconfirmed

nodes.name: PayVerifiedDifference
nodes.role: pay only the confirmed difference to the confirmed Apple payee

nodes.name: NotifyUser
nodes.role: tell the user the outcome and the reasons, including any warning that the call may be a scam
